title: Align Node and Rust commit-input eligibility for non-UTF-8 ordinary tracked paths
outcome: The committed-input producers use one explicit rule for ordinary non-UTF-8 tracked paths on Unix, with a named refusal if unsupported and parity evidence, without silently changing the content-v1 path encoding contract.
acceptance: Align Node and Rust commit-input eligibility for non-UTF-8 ordinary tracked paths is done
